entire point of entertainment is to get

have education, where the point of
education is to get someone to change
what they do, right? If you try and
teach someone how to answer a phone, the
phone rings, and they don't do
something, and then after they watch you
do something, they then change what they
do in the phone rings the second time,
they have learned. So, the point is to
change their behavior. If the video or
the content does that, then you've
succeeded in educating them. And lastly,
you have edutainment, which has the
point of both trying to teach and
entertaining at the same time. You can
mix one thing that entertains some
people, and then that same thing
educates other people. I just want to
make this very clear that you don't
control the audience. You make
something, and then education or
entertainment occurs. Some creators
might learn stuff from Mr. Beast videos.
Wow, I learned how to make videos. But
the vast majority of people are
entertained. They watch just to watch.
On the other hand, Walipop, who's one of
the number one educators on YouTube, he
may entertain some enthusiasts around
that subject, but mostly he educates
students.
